response: The clustering remains entirely topic-based after three rounds of feedback. I need a fundamental restructuring: discard all five current clusters and rebuild exactly four clusters where every paper is assigned based solely on its primary research method — Observational, Theoretical, Simulation, or Instrumental/Methods. A gravitational-wave paper using analytical derivations belongs with theoretical cosmology and stellar theory papers; a galaxy survey paper belongs with observational stellar and planetary papers; a hydrodynamics simulation of AGN belongs with N-body and MHD simulation papers across all topics. The subject matter of a paper should have zero influence on its cluster assignment.
